run_train_ivf_centroids: train IVF centroids using k-means clustering on a dataset with GPU acceleration
run_train_index: train a FAISS IVF+RQ index by encoding training vectors and computing residual codebooks
run_add_vectors: add database vectors to a trained IVF+RQ index by encoding and storing codes with norms
run_search_index: search an IVF+RQ index with autotuned nprobe and shortlist parameters and compute recall
run_main_pipeline: run the full IVF search pipeline with train, add, and search phases via CLI arguments
